messages:
maria (AM): Hey team — new POC with QuantVista. Need a billing org + project for a 6-week pilot. Requirements: $15k spend cap, ephemeral API keys for engineers, can fallback to Dedicated pool if hosted capacity spikes. Also needs VPC peering for private hosted endpoints. Can infra/security provision?

alex (SDR): Adding the QuantVista contract + legal thumb. Contact is sam@quantvista.ai

samir (infra): I can do the org/project and enable spend cap. Need the exact project id and whether they want auto-rotate ephemeral keys. Also: do they need Dedicated pool reserved or just on-demand fallback?

maria (AM): Prefer on-demand Dedicated fallback with a burst policy (up to 2x baseline). Project id: quantvista-poc-2025. Enable ephemeral auto-rotate. Cap: $15,000 USD. Start date: 2025-06-01. End date: 2025-07-12.

samir (infra): Got it. I'll provision project and set spend_cap_usd=15000. Will create role 'quantvista-poc-engineer' with limited permissions. Confirming the CLI to set cap:
```
redwood projects update quantvista-poc-2025 --spend-cap 15000 --ephemeral-keys auto
```
Will also attach spend alerts to billing@quantvista.ai and cc: maria.

jesse (security): For VPC peering + private endpoints we need customer's CIDR ranges and whether they require KMS for keys. Also, ephemeral keys are fine if rotated by us every 24h. For Dedicated fallback, we'll ensure no model weights leave VPC — that's only on private deployment. We need an approved PCA + signed NDA.

maria (AM): They've signed the NDA. CIDR: 10.20.0.0/16. They want KMS-managed keys (customer-managed key). Are we able to support CMK during POC?

samir (infra): Yes — we can create customer-project-scoped KMS integration. I need the KMS key ARN and IAM principal to grant. If unavailable, we can use Redwood-managed key as fallback (must be noted in SOW).

ops-bot: Ticket #3421 created: org/proj provision + spend cap + ephemeral keys + VPC peering. Owner: @samir. ETA: 48h.

alex (SDR): Thanks! I'll share the onboarding doc with QuantVista and schedule a short handoff call. :thumbsup:

maria (AM): Perfect. If anyone hits blockers with Dedicated pool gating (quota/infra) ping me and I'll escalate to sales-engineering.
